title: UMM Input Data Schema
description: Standard schema for input data required by the Unified Marketing Measurement framework. All fields are weekly unless otherwise noted. See docs/data-requirements.md for detailed guidance on sourcing and preparing each field.

brand.description: Brand or business unit name. Used for labeling outputs.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this dataset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the reporting week. All dates are the Monday (start) of the reporting week.

start.description: First date in dataset. Must be a Monday for weekly data.

end.description: Last date in dataset. Must be a Monday for weekly data.

outcome_metric.description: The primary business outcome being modeled.

geography.description: Geographic scope of the dataset. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 for country-level, or describe the scope (e.g., 'US national', 'EMEA', 'California DMA').

notes.description: Free-text notes about this dataset — known data quality issues, unusual periods, structural breaks.

time_series.description: Array of weekly (or daily) observations. Each object represents one time period.

date.description: ISO 8601 date. For weekly data: the Monday starting the week. For daily: the calendar date.

outcome.description: Business outcome data for this period.

value.description: Value of the outcome metric (revenue in currency units, or count for conversions/orders/leads).

adjusted.description: Set true if this value has been adjusted for non-marketing factors (e.g., large non-marketing-driven B2B deals removed). If true, document the adjustment in metadata.notes.

spend.description: Marketing spend by channel for this period. All values in the currency specified in metadata.currency. Use 0 (not null) for channels with no spend in a given period.

paid_search_brand.description: Paid search spend targeting branded keywords (brand name, brand + product terms).

paid_search_nonbrand.description: Paid search spend targeting non-branded, category, and competitor keywords.

paid_social.description: Total paid social spend across all platforms (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Snapchat, X). Split by platform in spend_detail if available.

online_video.description: Online video spend (YouTube, OLV, pre-roll). Exclude CTV — report in tv_ctv.

tv_linear.description: Linear TV spend (national + local broadcast and cable).

ooh.description: Out-of-home spend (billboards, transit, DOOH combined unless separately material).

email.description: Email/CRM campaign spend (platform costs + production, excluding staff time).

affiliate.description: Affiliate and partner marketing spend (commission + platform fees).

retail_media.description: Retail media network spend (Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Criteo, etc.).

other.description: Any spend channel not covered above that represents >2% of total budget. Document in metadata.notes.

spend_detail.description: Optional platform-level spend breakdowns within the top-level channel categories. Use when platform-level splits are material and available.

covariates.description: Control variables that influence the outcome but are not marketing spend. Include all variables that apply — omitted variables can cause spend to absorb their effects.

price_index.description: Relative average selling price index (1.0 = baseline). Include if pricing changes materially during the data window.

distribution_index.description: Distribution coverage index (1.0 = baseline). Include if distribution changed during the data window (new retail partners, store openings/closures).

promotion_flag.description: 1 if a major promotional event occurred this period (sale, discount, bundle offer), 0 otherwise.

promotion_depth.description: Average promotional discount depth this period (0 = no discount, 0.2 = 20% off). Use instead of or alongside promotion_flag.

competitor_event_flag.description: 1 if a major competitor event occurred (launch, price cut, recall) that likely affected category demand, 0 otherwise.

holiday_flag.description: 1 if a major holiday falls within this period (country-specific), 0 otherwise. Supplement with specific holiday indicators in holiday_indicators.

holiday_indicators.description: Per-holiday binary indicators. Add any holiday relevant to the business.

consumer_confidence.description: Consumer confidence index value for the period (use national index appropriate to geography).

macro_category_index.description: Category-level spend index from third-party data (e.g., credit card spend index for the relevant category). Useful for separating macro demand shifts from media-driven growth.

anomaly_flag.description: 1 if this period contains an anomaly (data outage, COVID lockdown, supply disruption, one-time event) that should be modeled separately. Document in metadata.notes.

product_launch_flag.description: 1 if a major product launch occurred this period that would have had independent demand impact, 0 otherwise.

metadata.notes: TV spend is gross (before agency commission). Q2 2022 has a 2-week data gap imputed with linear interpolation — flagged with anomaly_flag.
